record.original_question: Let X be a compact complex manifold with a holomorphic Poisson structure. If X_s, the locus where the Poisson structure has rank s, is non-empty, must it contain a component of dimension greater than s?

evidence.quote: In general, we have a partition X = disjoint union over s even of X_s where X_s := {x in X | rk tau(x) = s}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a compact complex manifold equipped with a holomorphic Poisson structure, that is, a holomorphic bivector field $\tau \in H^0(X, \wedge^2 TX)$ satisfying the Schouten bracket condition $[\tau,\tau]=0$. For each point $x \in X$, the bivector $\tau(x) \in \wedge^2 T_x X$ has an even rank $\mathrm{rk}\,\tau(x)$, giving a stratification
$$X = \bigsqcup_{s \text{ even}} X_s, \qquad X_s := \{ x \in X \mid \mathrm{rk}\,\tau(x) = s \}.$$
Prove or disprove: whenever the stratum $X_s$ is non-empty, it contains an irreducible component of complex dimension strictly greater than $s$.
artifact.status_search_result: This is essentially Bondal's conjecture on the dimensions of degeneracy loci of holomorphic Poisson structures. It was proved by Polishchuk in dimension 3, and Gualtieri–Pym established further cases (e.g. Fano fourfolds and the maximal degeneracy locus on projective space). A 2026 note ("A note on Bondal's conjecture") and subsequent work address additional cases (e.g. flag varieties), but the conjecture in full generality remains open with no known counterexample.

status_evidence.title: Poisson modules and degeneracy loci
status_evidence.snippet: Gualtieri and Pym provide evidence in favor of Bondal's conjecture that the rank ≤ 2k locus of a Fano Poisson manifold always has dimension ≥ 2k+1, in particular for Fano fourfolds.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results: Bondal's conjecture verified in additional cases including Fano fourfolds.

status_evidence.title: Algebraic geometry of Poisson brackets (Polishchuk)
status_evidence.snippet: Polishchuk proved Bondal's conjecture in dimension 3.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture holds for compact complex manifolds of dimension ≤ 3.

status_evidence.title: A note on Bondal's conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Recent note discussing Bondal's conjecture; conjecture not yet established in full generality.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: The Poisson degeneracy locus of a Flag Variety
status_evidence.snippet: Studies degeneracy loci on flag varieties in connection with Bondal's conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Further partial results on specific classes of varieties.
